decision: I approved the build with readiness 'ready_with_gaps'
I chose default pool sizing, maxIdleTimeMS=120000, and 10-second connect/server-selection timeouts for this sequential local CLI.
reason: Sequential ingestion and one interactive request at a time do not need pool tuning; bounded startup enables a useful failure message without imposing a short limit on index builds.
evidence: documentdb-connection requires workload context; review assumes a local CLI with bounded provider calls.

decision: I chose exact pins llamaindex 0.12.1, @llamaindex/openai 0.4.22, and mongodb 6.22.0, with npm and a committed lockfile.
reason: Provider peers match the current umbrella package; driver matches review's 6.x assumption and lockfile fixes transitive versions.
evidence: npm view: llamaindex 0.12.1 uses core 0.6.22/env 0.1.30; openai 0.4.22 peers match those, while 0.4.23 requires core 0.6.23/env 0.1.31; mongodb 6.22.0 is latest returned 6.x.
